scoring_justification: MAE is recomputed from the agent's reported total energies per angle/strain and compared to hidden reference MAE derived from paper Fig.4; full recompute of total energies is impossible, but recomputing the headline MAE from the raw artifact qualifies as T1.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference MAE values (max magnitude per strain state) derived from paper Fig.4.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.4: relaxed ~40 ueV/f.u., tensile enhanced, compressive ~7 ueV/f.u.; sin^2 angular dependence assumed.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and approximated with sin^2(theta) model.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's published values for the headline MAE trend; used to verify the agent's computed MAE against the same physical result.

outputs.description: Magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) as a function of spin orientation angle for relaxed, 1% tensile and 1% compressive in-plane strain. The checker compares the reported MAE values to hidden reference values from the paper and verifies that the overall MAE versus angle trends are physically consistent.

output_contract.notes: The output file is scored. The agent must compute MAE from total energy differences; the hidden checker will compare the reported MAE values at specific angles against the paper's reference MAE and check physical consistency.
